demo.reason: Touch-controlled hour details, first-12/next-12 paging on compact slots, and saved-location switching are meaningful interactions worth showing.

features.title: A full day of weather, not a wall of cards.
features.subtitle: Pro extends the timeline with more horizon and the details you reach for after the first glance.
items: Large slots show the full day; compact slots page between the first 12 and next 12 hours.
Feels-like temperature, precipitation amount, wind, and UV appear when you want the deeper read.
Switch saved locations from the display instead of digging back through settings.
Sunrise, sunset, civil dawn, and civil dusk are integrated into the forecast timeline.

showcase.title: The whole forecast day in one ribbon.
showcase.subtitle: Twenty-four hours use the width of XENEON Edge while compact slots keep the same information readable through paging.

settings.title: More detail when you ask for it.
settings.subtitle: Hour details, next-12 paging, saved places, and weather states add depth without cluttering the main glance.

sizes.title: More forecast without smaller text.
